input.quote: Garman is the owner of all intellectual property rights in the Work (including any Improvements or Modifications thereto), including all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. No title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 13 gives Garman ownership of all IP in the Work "including any Improvements or Modifications thereto" — i.e. including the Modifications specified in Schedule "D" that we commission and pay for — while our only counterbalancing right is the Section 2 non-exclusive, non-transferable object-code use licence limited to Authorized Locations (with no right to modify or sublicense) and a source-code licence in Section 16(b) that is contingent on Garman's default or bankruptcy. That falls short of the fallback, which requires a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the deliverables we fund. The Agreement is also silent on ownership of our data, even though Section 4(b) has Garman converting Sparkling's data. There is no assignment of our IP or data to Garman and no joint ownership, so walk-away territory is not reached. Given the Modifications are changes to Garman's own platform, we propose the fallback (licence-back) rather than an assignment, plus a confirmation that our data remains ours.

proposal.summary: Add Sparkling data ownership and a perpetual, irrevocable licence to the Modifications Sparkling funds, without disturbing Garman's ownership of its platform.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 13 vests all IP in Garman, including the Modifications we specify and pay for, and the Agreement nowhere confirms that our data stays ours. We are content for Garman to keep its platform, so we have added a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Modifications for our business and a statement that we retain all rights in our data, including data converted under Section 4.

ops.text: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Garman hereby grants to Sparkling a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free and fully paid licence to use, modify (and have modified) and sublicense the Modifications and any other materials developed specifically for Sparkling and paid for by Sparkling, for Sparkling's business purposes. Sparkling retains all right, title and interest in and to Sparkling's data and information (including data converted pursuant to Section 4), and nothing in this Agreement transfers or assigns to Garman any right, title or interest in such data or information. No intellectual property is jointly owned by the parties.
